summary.text: Mark Rendon is the Green Party candidate for California State Assembly District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Buffy Wicks (D).
He is an educator who, according to his Ballotpedia survey answers, taught music in the Oakland Unified School District for 29 years.

paragraphs.text: Mark Rendon earned a bachelor's degree from the Manhattan School of Music in 1984 and a graduate degree from the University of California, Berkeley in 1990.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Sacramento, grew up in Washington, DC, and received a master's in education administration at UC Berkeley.

He said he was a music teacher in the Oakland Unified School District for 29 years and served in the Oakland Education Association as a site representative, executive board member, treasurer, secretary and representative to the California Teachers Association State Council.
Rendon said he has been a member of the Green Party since the early 1990s.
Rendon advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary for Assembly District 14.
In the survey, he listed his key campaign messages as CalCare (Medicare for All), ending the housing crisis through social housing, and a public bank.
